newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson signs 530 mln skr Colombia deal.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson signs 530 mln skr Colombia deal.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group LM AB Ericsson said on Monday it had signed AXE and SHD contracts worth 530 million crowns with two telecommunications operators in Colombia.
One contract, valued at 340 million crowns, was with Empresa de Telecomunicaciones de Santa Fe de Bogota.
It included AXE switching equipment for extensions and upgrades of the public network.
"The contracts also includes Synchronous Digital Network transport network solutions, enabling broadband services at speeds up to 2.5 Gbps," Ericsson said in a statement.
These deliveries were extensions to the SHD network Ericsson installed in 1996.
The second contract, valued at 190 million crowns, was with Empresas Publicas de Medellin.
This included AXE-switching equipment, Intelligent Network solutions and management systems, Ericsson said.
Ericsson said it now had 1.8 million AXE-lines installed or on order in Colombia, making Ericsson one of the leading suppliers of fixed telecoms equipment on the market.
